notes: Prologue-only site tiers. 'garage' and 'small_unit' are Act I's own tiers (claude_act1-content_sites.json) and are NOT redefined here — the prologue unlocks them as-is so the handover to Act I is seamless (doc 23 §4.1). This file adds the two tiers that exist only before the garage: the player's bedroom and a spare room.

capacity_kw.source: ≈ a single 15A US household circuit derated 80% (~1.44kW) shared with the rest of the room; the PC alone draws ~0.09kW so this cap only starts to bind once a GPU is added

power_usd_kwh.source: Household pays while the player lives at home (doc 23 §3) — power is 'free' to the player's own cash, but load above household_threshold_kw triggers household cards

household_threshold_kw.source: ≈ above this a parent notices the electric bill / room heat

tiers.household_heat_note: Bedroom and home_rig don't use Community Heat (no neighbours) — they use a separate household_patience resource that random 'household cards' draw down instead.

capacity_kw.source: doc 23 §4.1 placeholder, kept: roughly a 20A circuit derated (~1.9kW) minus headroom for the rest of the spare room's normal load

power_usd_kwh.source: still household power while living at home

capex_usd.source: ≈ a used desk, shelving, a couple of surge-protected power strips — flavour cost, not a real infrastructure spend

household_patience.effect_at_zero: forces a move-out decision or a load cutback (parents unplug the rig) — design flag, tune in sim

household_rules.ends_when: player takes the Move Out sink (doc 23 §7); from then on the player pays for power at garage-tier rates ($0.12/kWh, Act I's own path) and Community Heat replaces household_patience
